scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream tunic and rust-brown mantle kneels with open hands beneath an olive tree. A stony path winds through golden grasses toward a distant hill town under a blue sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: David's kneeling posture imagines his inquiry of the LORD. The ascending path and distant town suggest the direction to Hebron. The verse does not specify this posture, landscape, clothing, or a view of Hebron; these are illustrative choices, not historical likenesses. God remains unseen, and the picture does not invent how His answer was conveyed.
